with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-cpu-optimization-full-build-and-lints-root-v1';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()

 def save(): (out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')

 try:

  assert all(m.sha(W/p)==digest for p,digest in pins.items());r['source_pins']=pins;r['cpu_receipt']=ident(p)

   row['file']=str(existing[relative]);row['arguments']=[adapt(x) for x in row.get('arguments',shlex.split(row.get('command','')))];row.pop('command',None);rows.append(row)
  (db/'compile_commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
  baseline,bso,bse=run('baseline-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*[str(p) for p in existing.values()]],env=dict(ENV,STRATA_LINT_BUILD=str(db)),wall=700,allowed=(0,1))
  candidate,cso,cse=run('candidate-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files],env=dict(ENV,STRATA_LINT_BUILD=str(W/'build/free')),wall=700,allowed=(0,1))
  for name in ['clang-tidy','cppcheck','cmake-lint','codespell','reuse']:
   assert '== '+name in bso and '== '+name in cso
  assert 'skipped (' not in bso+cso and 'possible secret' not in bso+cso

  added=list((collections.Counter(after)-collections.Counter(before)).elements())
  r['lint_comparison']=dict(baseline_exit=baseline['exit_code'],candidate_exit=candidate['exit_code'],baseline=before,candidate=after,added=added,padding_comparisons=leg.PADDING_COMPARISONS,normalization='Exact unchanged lines/messages mapped to0691bcdf; new files have no baseline findings. Unchanged named Options/Verifier excess padding may not increase.')
  save();assert not added
  for mode in ['free','contrib-llvm']:
   run('whole-reuse-'+mode,[str(L/'venv/bin/reuse'),'lint','--quiet'],wall=180)
  assert all(m.sha(W/p)==digest for p,digest in pins.items())
  r['complete']=True
 except BaseException as e:r['error']=repr(e);r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
 finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'));save()
